sonora_ca.name: Sonora
sonora_ca.obs_note: Sonora has no NWS observing station. The readings come from the Green Spring fire-weather station, 12 miles away and about 700 ft lower.

alerts.headline: Heat Advisory issued October 6 at 11:32AM PDT until October 9 at 10:00PM PDT by NWS Sacramento CA
alerts.description: * WHAT...High temperatures of 94 to 102 degrees expected and overnight low temperatures in the mid 60s to low 70s, with widespread Moderate HeatRisk and areas of Major HeatRisk.  * WHERE...The Sacramento and northern San Joaquin Valleys, Delta and Carquinez Strait, and foothills.  * WHEN...Until 10 PM PDT Friday.  * IMPACTS...Hot temperatures may cause heat illnesses, especially to anyone without effective cooling and/or adequate hydration.  * ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Hottest days expected Tuesday through Thursday.

alerts.headline: Extreme Heat Warning issued October 6 at 3:02PM PDT until October 9 at 8:00PM PDT by NWS Las Vegas NV
alerts.description: * WHAT...Dangerously hot conditions with high temperatures near 110 degrees and overnight lows only getting down to around 85 degrees. This will yield at least major Heat Risk, impacting anyone without adequate cooling and hydration.  * WHERE...Elevations in Death Valley National Park below 2000 feet.  * WHEN...Until 8 PM PDT Friday.  * IMPACTS...Heat-related illnesses increase significantly during extreme heat events.
